about_the_game:
🐭💥 SAVE YOUR FAMILY BEFORE IT'S TOO LATE! 💥🐭

🚀 A MISSILE IS COMING! YOUR CHILDREN ARE TRAPPED! YOU HAVE SECONDS TO SAVE THEM!

You are a desperate rat father racing against time to save your children from a 40-floor building before everything goes up in flames!

  • ⚡ RUN, JUMP, AND WALL-CLIMB to navigate through each floor at lightning speed!

  • 💣 DODGE MISSILES & SOLVE PUZZLES to reach your children before it’s too late!

  • 🏆 COLLECT CHEESE & FINISH LEVELS AS FAST AS POSSIBLE to earn 3-star rankings!

  • 🔥 EVERY 10 FLOORS, A SPECIAL FAMILY MEMBER NEEDS SAVING! Face new intense challenges!

  • 🎭 2 DIFFERENT ENDINGS – How many lives can you save before time runs out?

⏳ TIME IS RUNNING OUT! CAN YOU SAVE THEM ALL? ⏳
